quote: A quiet little book with a huge heart. It gave us a new way to talk about being there for someone without trying to fix everything.
My daughter saw herself in every failed attempt—and then got up to try again. It made perseverance feel funny, warm and completely possible.
The perfect antidote to ‘I can't’. We read it before art time and suddenly one tiny mark feels like an invitation instead of a test.
A tender, accessible story about noticing who is left out. It opened up a lovely conversation about small acts that make someone feel seen.
The colors gave my three-year-old a vocabulary for feelings before she had the words herself. It is now a regular bedtime favorite.
